review_notes: Decode a real chunked request body using a hexadecimal size. The rewrite decodes sizes as decimal, consumes the wrong CRLF width and continues after the terminal chunk. Retain hexadecimal chunk framing, exact CRLF consumption and terminal-chunk completion. Original F2P/P2P unchanged. Baseline diagnostic failure is expected task reproduction, not a policy error. Source imports asserted against the workspace before and after the repair.

arguments.command:
python3 - <<'PYREPLAY'
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib, importlib
expected=(Path.cwd() / 'bottle.py').resolve()
try:
 module = importlib.import_module('bottle')
except Exception as import_error:
 traceback=import_error.__traceback__
 while traceback is not None:
  file=traceback.tb_frame.f_globals.get('__file__')
  if file and Path(file).resolve()==expected:
   print('source_binding', str(expected), 'sha256', hashlib.sha256(expected.read_bytes()).hexdigest(), 'actual_import_failure_frame')
  traceback=traceback.tb_next
 raise
actual=Path(module.__file__).resolve()
print("source_binding", str(actual), "sha256", hashlib.sha256(actual.read_bytes()).hexdigest())
assert actual == expected, (actual, expected)
import io
from bottle import BaseRequest
raw=b'A\r\n0123456789\r\n0\r\n\r\n';r=BaseRequest({'wsgi.input':io.BytesIO(raw),'HTTP_TRANSFER_ENCODING':'chunked'});value=r.body.read();print('decoded_chunked_request',value)
assert value==b'0123456789'
